title: Solver arm output — one JSON document per arm per suite
description: The solver agent's final message must be exactly this document. Bytes are self-logged (`<cmd> > out; wc -c < out`) for CLI arms; MCP arms log the chars of each tool_result content instead. Judges never see which arm produced which document (blind).
